zen.text: Kozilek, one of the three Eldrazi titans, was bound by Nahiri, Ugin and Sorin within the Eye of Ugin, but the titans later emerged and began unraveling Zendikar's natural forces.
At Sea Gate, Kozilek rose from the bay and ripped open the sea wall, called up by Ob Nixilis, and a shimmering wave from him killed soldiers who were fleeing the collapsing city.
He took control of Shen and cleaved Lorthos in two, leaving Kiora to realize that he had never seen her and that she had killed her own followers.

Kiora came to understand that Kozilek was a distortion phenomenon from the Blind Eternities, and Nissa wove Zendikar's leylines into a glyph that held the titans until Chandra ignited the leylines and the titans were destroyed in a blinding blast.

ogw.text: When Kozilek emerged at Sea Gate, his brood swarmed to the surface and he destroyed the city, and distant Valakut could not contain its grief.
Jace and Nissa had imprisoned Ulamog in a hedron network at Sea Gate, but Ob Nixilis's interference made it fail and he called Kozilek to join Ulamog.
Jace discovered the leyline pattern needed to anchor the titans, and Nissa traced it on her world, binding Ulamog and Kozilek in a web of leylines.
Chandra then attacked, with Nissa channeling leyline mana to her, igniting the leylines and incinerating both titans, which ended Kozilek's material manifestation on Zendikar and angered Ugin.
